module_summary: Timer control FSM: detects serial pattern 1101, asserts shift_ena four cycles, waits on done_counting, then holds done until ack.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: 10-state controller: pattern search, 4 shift states, Count and Wait

anchors.name: shift_ena
anchors.why: Decoded in B0-B3; enables external shift of 4 delay bits

anchors.name: counting
anchors.why: Asserted in Count state while waiting for external counters

anchors.name: done
anchors.why: Level asserted in Wait state signaling timer expiry until ack

anchors.name: ack
anchors.why: User acknowledgement returning FSM from Wait to pattern search

anchors.name: done_counting
anchors.why: Counter completion input moving FSM from Count to Wait

groups.name: Timer control FSM
groups.description: Pattern detection, shift, count wait and ack-wait sequencing

groups.name: Output decode
groups.description: Moore decode of state into shift_ena, counting, done
